grants.description: Validate your Tell Us Once reference number issued by the registrar
grants.purpose: To confirm you have permission to use Tell Us Once and that the reference is valid

grants.description: Share details about the person who died with government organisations
grants.purpose: To notify government organisations and update their records

grants.description: Share details of the deceased's passport and driving licence for cancellation
grants.purpose: To cancel the passport and driving licence with HMPO and DVLA

grants.description: Share details of vehicles registered to the deceased
grants.purpose: To remove the deceased as registered keeper and end vehicle tax for up to 5 vehicles

grants.description: Share details of benefits, State Pension and public sector pensions the deceased was receiving
grants.purpose: To cancel benefit and pension payments and prevent overpayments that would need to be repaid

grants.description: Share details of local council services the deceased was receiving
grants.purpose: To cancel Housing Benefit, Council Tax Reduction, Blue Badge and update electoral register

grants.description: Share details of the person dealing with the deceased's estate
grants.purpose: So organisations can contact the executor or administrator about the deceased's affairs

grants.description: Share details of the surviving spouse or civil partner (if applicable)
grants.purpose: To update records for joint benefits or entitlements and check eligibility for bereavement support

grants.description: Share details of where the death occurred (if in hospital, care home, nursing home or hospice)

revocation.mechanism: Contact the organisations directly after using Tell Us Once. You cannot revoke the notification itself once submitted.
revocation.effect: Once Tell Us Once has notified organisations, those organisations will have updated their records. You must contact them individually to make further changes.

delegation.agent_identity: GOV.UK AI Agent acting on behalf of the executor, administrator, next of kin or bereaved family member
delegation.limitations: Agent cannot obtain the Tell Us Once reference number on your behalf - you must get this from the registrar. Agent cannot provide consent on behalf of executors, administrators, surviving spouses or next of kin - you must have their explicit permission first. Agent cannot change which organisations are notified (all applicable organisations will be notified automatically). Agent cannot handle private pensions, banks or insurance - you must contact those separately.
